title: festuca rupicola f. ciliata
intro: Festuca rupicola f. ciliata, commonly known as mountain fescue, is a perennial grass species. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Festuca rupicola f. ciliata include modulating immune responses, reducing oxidative stress, and exhibiting antimicrobial activities. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
